title: Olive’s Island
tagline: Teach little robots with real coding blocks, then put them to work on a 3D island where the neighbours need a hand.
readinessNote: A request (a level) is one JSON entry in Data/Requests: its 8×6 map in letters, the things on it, the goal as named checks, the blocks offered, the reward, plus its words in Data/Words. A new goal kind, block or tile is engine code in scripts/engine.js. The optional AI helper is switched off (OLIVE_ON in scripts/olive.js) and four requests that need it are hidden.
buildYourOwn: New requests and islanders, new things on the island, rewards, robots and their upgrades, shop items, and your own words in English and French.
controls: Mouse or touch: tap or drag blocks; drag the island to look around, pinch or wheel to zoom
